answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. By the mesa of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
